asset.name: GeneratedForm
asset.description: The schema-driven form compiling data, layout, validation, dependency, permission, and action schemas into a cached field-dependency graph with polished defaults and no per-consumer configuration.

requires.reason: The runtime is the shared form, not a parallel implementation.
Generated fields compose the shared field relationships.
Visibility and enablement come from the compiled dependency graph.
Derived values come from the same graph.

suggests.reason: Only schemas with date fields need it, and it brings a calendar and timezone policy with it.
Only schemas with colour fields need it.
Only schemas with rich text or code fields need it, and it is the largest optional dependency in the catalog.
Only schemas with structured multi-value fields need it.
Only schemas with file fields need it, and it requires an upload adapter.

rationale: The clearest demonstration of the requires-versus-suggests split. Its hard closure is nine shared form pieces; the eleven field types a given schema might use stay optional, so adopting a generated form does not drag a calendar, a colour spectrum, and a code editor into a scenario that needs none of them.
